{{Infobox Monster |name = Dagannoth Rex (Echo) |image = [[File:Dagannoth Rex (Echo).png|190px]] |release = [[27 November]] [[2024]] |update = Leagues V: Raging Echoes OUT NOW! |members = Yes |combat = 454 |size = 3 |examine = Firstborn of the legendary dagannoth kings. |attributes = |xpbonus = |max hit = 48+ |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Slash]] |attack speed = 5 |slaylvl = None |slayxp = 727 |cat = Bosses, Dagannoth |assignedby = vannaka,chaeldar,konar,nieve,duradel |hitpoints = 1800 |att = 400 |str = 400 |def = 255 |mage = 0 |range = 255 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 100 |dslash = 100 |dcrush = 100 |dmagic = 10 |dlight = 100 |dstandard = 100 |dheavy = 100 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 100 |id = override2267 |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} '''Echo Dagannoth Rex''' is a more challenging variant of [[Dagannoth Rex]] that was accessible during the [[Raging Echoes League]] and [[Demonic Pacts League]]. To fight the Echo Dagannoth Kings the player must have a [[Fremennik echo orb]], which is dropped by the regular [[Dagannoth Kings]], in their inventory. The kings share a health bar of 1800. During the fight, two of them will use protection prayers against all styles. It is best to damage the king with no overheads. After a certain amount of damage poison will scatter over random tiles and the kings will rotate which 2 have overhead prayers activated. Near the end in the enrage phase, they will all drop their overheads and the random poison tiles increase frequently. It is similar to the sunlight beams of during the [[Sol Heredit]] fight. When they are killed you will complete the Combat Achievements of "[[Rapid Succession]]" and "[[Toppling the Diarchy]]". ==Drops== {{Main|Dagannoth_Rex#Drops}} The Dagannoth Rex (Echo) drops a standard roll of the normal Dagannoth Rex's drops on every kill, in addition to a roll of potentially receiving one of its unique echo items. {{DropsTableHead|bucket=no}} {{DropsLine|name=V's helm|quantity=1|rarity=1/25|gemw=No|raritynotes={{refn|group=d|In addition to having a 1/25 chance to drop, players will '''always''' receive V's helm on their 50th Dagannoth Kings (Echo) kill if they haven't received one yet.}}}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 23 April 2026 |update = Leagues VI Changes |change = Echo Dagannoth Rex's melee and ranged defence were reduced from 255 to 100. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Dagannoth Rex (Echo) (Raging Echoes League).png|300x150px]] |[[File:Dagannoth Rex (Echo).png|300x150px]] |- |27 November 2024–
